findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "hasdata_youtube_video_getYoutubeVideo" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get YouTube Video Data Fetches a single YouTube video by its 11-character `videoId`. Returns title, thumbnail, raw + normalized views and likes, `lengthSeconds`…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
